ded: The amount you pay yourself before the plan starts paying its share.
oop: Most you pay in a year
The "out-of-pocket maximum". Once you have paid this much in a year, the plan pays 100% of covered care.
coins: After the deductible, you and the plan split each bill by percentage. "You pay 20%" means on a $1,000 bill you pay $200.
pre: A "pre-existing condition" is a health problem you had before the plan started.
max: The most the plan will pay in total, for the period shown.
doc: A regular visit to a primary care doctor. A "copay" is a fixed amount you pay at each visit.
evac: Transport to a hospital that can treat you when local care isn't enough.
repat: Transport back to your home country after a serious illness.
chiro: Treatment of joints and spine by a chiropractor.
bedside: Travel costs for a family member to come to you if you're in hospital.
sports: Extra cover for injuries from school sports.
